purpose: Test whether Aimee's economizer plus a sliding-window write-progress controller converts context runway into a completed, tested repair on a task where the plain agent previously exceeded its context window.

conditions.off: Unmodified canonical transcript and no progress controller.
conditions.aimee_progress: Production Go economizer plus the production-equivalent write-progress controller.

secondary_outcomes: plain condition reaches a context-limit error
provider-reported billable input and output tokens
success_claim: A context-capacity crossover requires off unresolved specifically because of context_limit and aimee_progress hidden-passed. Test-authorship claims additionally require candidate-visible green and the authored test-only patch red on the buggy parent.
stopping_rule: Run every planned cell to submit, assistant final, provider/context failure, progress abort, or 30 turns. Do not change thresholds, prompts, task, grader, or stopping rules after dispatch begins.
interpretation_guardrail: A non-completing treatment may support token, context, or liveness diagnostics but may not be described as a completion crossover. One repeat remains exploratory and is not a population estimate.
